governanceAuthority: SECP Engineering Truth & Forensic Verification Directorate
justification: While mathematical and kinematic foundations exist (e.g. OCCT B-Rep boolean intersection in AssemblyInterferenceEngine and 15-axis SAT in assembly clash), the multi-axis CAM and kinematic clearance engines contain severe mathematical omissions (vertex-only/centroid-only triangle tests, discrete 10-point capsule sampling, hardcoded 30mm offsets), fail-open exception handling, and complete disconnection from active CAD document geometry in the UI.
